svg.text: Secure-by-Design Architecture Evolution: 2021 Default vs. 2026 Modern Standard
From Perimeter Firewalls, localStorage JWTs & Post-Build Pen-Tests to BFF + OAuth 2.1, SPIFFE mTLS, Domain Primitives & SLSA L3 Gates
Architectural Dimension
2021 Perimeter & Damage-Control Default
2026 Secure-by-Design Standard
1. Browser Auth &
Token Custody
SPA localStorage JWTs + Implicit flow + static API keys
Any XSS exfiltrates bearer & refresh tokens; stateless JWTs cannot
be revoked cleanly on compromise or privilege downgrade
BFF + OAuth 2.1 PKCE + HttpOnly/SameSite Cookies + RTR / DPoP
Tokens stay server-side in BFF or sender-constrained via DPoP;
Fetch Metadata (Sec-Fetch-Site) + CSP nonces + Passkeys (WebAuthn)
2. East-West Service
& Event Trust
Flat VPC / perimeter VPN + shared static service secrets
One SSRF or compromised pod pivots freely across internal subnets
and publishes forged events onto unauthenticated internal queues
SPIFFE/SPIRE mTLS SVIDs + Cryptographically Signed Async Events
Short-lived auto-rotated workload certs enforce zero-trust L7 calls;
consumers verify publisher signatures before processing broker events
3. Authorization &
Multi-Tenancy
Scattered controller if-checks + coarse RBAC + ORM mass binding
One missing WHERE tenant_id = ? creates BOLA/IDOR data leaks;
controller DTO binding leaks privileged columns (BOPLA)
DDD Domain Primitives + Cedar/Zanzibar ReBAC + PostgreSQL RLS
TenantScopedResourceId & allowlist DTOs block BOLA at compile/type
boundary; default-deny forbid-overrides-permit + DB RLS backstop
4. Org Cryptography
& Data Privacy
Ad-hoc AES-CBC, bcrypt (72-byte trap), RSA-2048 & manual deletion
Each repo picks ciphers independently; CBC padding oracles & GCM
nonce reuse slip in; immutable backups break GDPR erasure SLAs
Central Crypto SDK (AES-256-GCM/SIV, Argon2id) + PQC + Crypto-Shred
KMS envelope encryption + DEK rotation; hybrid X25519MLKEM768;
regional residency cells + per-subject key destruction for erasure
5. CI/CD Gates &
Supply Chain Triage
Annual manual pen-tests + CVSS-only alerts + advisory scans
Leaked secrets reach main; scanner crashes fail open as "green";
teams drown in unexploitable CVSS 7+ alerts while missing KEVs
Fail-Closed CI Gates + SLSA L3 + Signed SBOM + KEV/EPSS/SSVC
Push protection + SAST + IaC policy + Sigstore provenance block
prod fail-closed; OWASP Top 10:2025 (A03, A10) & ASVS 5.0 mapped
Key Architectural Takeaway: Make Insecure States Unrepresentable Instead of Relying on After-the-Fact Audits
• Security debt compounds 10x per lifecycle stage: fixing a broken trust boundary during HLD costs an hour of design, whereas patching a
BOLA leak or nonce-reuse defect in production costs incident response, data migrations, and regulatory fines. Compose defenses across
edge, gateway, domain primitives, database RLS, framework masking, and fail-closed CI gates so no single developer mistake breaks the system.
